limitations: Model-based reanalysis at the selected area's centroid; not an in-situ measurement or a forest-only spatial average.
No anomaly, drought index, causal driver or model embedding is fabricated from this short context window.
ERA5 can lag by five days; missing days remain missing, and monthly sums may be partial.

water_balance.definition: Sum of daily precipitation minus reference ET₀ on dates with both values. ET₀ represents atmospheric demand for a well-watered reference grass surface, not measured forest evapotranspiration. This climatic balance is not an ecosystem water budget, a drought diagnosis, a standardized anomaly or a causal driver score.
water_balance.missing_data: Only same-day valid pairs contribute; absent dates and either missing input remain missing.
